name: Godot AI (MCP for the live Godot editor)
what: Lets LOKI's agents drive a live Godot 4.7+ editor: 46 tools - scenes, nodes, scripts, signals, UI, materials, animation, particles, cameras.

add-to-project.what: Put the Godot AI add-on into a Godot project and switch it on (then open the project in Godot 4.7+; LOKI's agents connect by themselves - they need uv installed).

notes: Needs Godot 4.7+ and uv (astral.sh/uv). LOKI's OpenCode agent gets it as the 'godot-ai' MCP server (uvx ... godot-ai==<the add-on's version> godot-ai attach) when a project in LOKI Projects has addons/godot_ai. Update it from the add-on's own dock, never by copying over it.
verified_from: README.md Quick start; plugin/addons/godot_ai/plugin.cfg version 4.3.1; docs/client-configuration.md attach command (tag v4.3.1)
